label: prf:emergence-to-quantum-flat
title: Proof of From Tannakian emergence to 2-group quantum flatness
html:
The argument proceeds in three steps.

Step 1: The volume constraint determines the Lie algebra. The categorical volume constraint provides a non-degenerate epimorphism \epsilon \colon \Lambda^2 V \to \mathbf{1}. Under the forgetful functor \tau, this endows the rank-2 module \tau(V) with a q-antisymmetric pairing whose invariance algebra is \mathfrak{su}_q(2). This is the Lie algebra of the reconstructed group G_q, and hence of the identity crossed module \partial \colon G_q \xrightarrow{\mathrm{id}} G_q defining the strict inner-automorphism 2-group \mathrm{INN}(G_q) under the crossed-module classification of John C. Baez and Aaron D. Lauda [baez2004].

Step 2: The determinant-one condition descends to the 2-form datum. For a general crossed module \partial \colon H \to G_q, vanishing fake curvature [baez-schreiber2007, §4] imposes F_A = \mathrm{d}\partial(B); for \mathrm{INN}(G_q) (\partial = \mathrm{id}_{G_q}), a 2-connection (A, B) takes values in \mathfrak{g}_q = \mathfrak{su}_q(2) and quantum flatness sets B = F_A directly, so B inherits the tracelessness forced by the determinant constraint \det(g_V) = 1 of \mathrm{SU}(2) emergence: B is \mathrm{Ad}(P)-valued with \mathrm{tr}B = 0, i.e. \mathfrak{su}_q(2)-valued rather than \mathfrak{gl}_q(2)-valued.

Step 3: Simplicity plus quantum flatness gives the instanton equation. Imposing the simplicity constraint B \in \Gamma(\Lambda^+\!H^* \otimes \mathrm{Ad}(P)) (self-dual 2-group) and combining with F_A = B yields F_A = F_A^+, hence F_A^- = 0. Infinitesimally, the equivalence between vanishing fake curvature and F_A^- = 0 under simplicity holds for any crossed module whose Lie-algebra differential \mathrm{d}\partial \colon \mathfrak{h} \to \mathfrak{g}_q is an isomorphism; selecting \mathrm{INN}(G_q) uniquely among strict 2-groups over G_q requires in addition group-level faithfulness \ker(\partial) = 1 and surjectivity \mathrm{coker}(\partial) = 1 so no discrete central kernel or outer quotient remains. Step 1 guarantees the structure group is \mathrm{SU}_q(2)---not a quotient of \mathrm{GL}_q(2)---so the instanton moduli space carries the gauge symmetry dictated by the categorical axioms.
